text:
marta: Heads-up: saved views in Console are confusing users. They see 'Active model: model-sigma' but traffic is going to model-sigma-quant due to a canary. People think save pinned the model. Should Console display computed/effective routing or only the saved policy id?

ken: Steps to repro?

marta: Open route /orders -> models, pick preset 'cost-optimized', save and share. Receiver sees 'Active model: model-sigma' while runtime chose model-sigma-quant.

sam: Our view objects only store policy_id + filters. Router resolves variants at inference time. Options: snapshot at save, compute-on-load, or show policy-only with help text.

alex: Compute-on-load preferred. Show both: policy + small 'routing preview' row with computed variant and as-of timestamp. Emit telemetry when preview != canonical.

devex: Rollout behind FF. Add 'share policy' vs 'share snapshot (pin model)' on share flow. Snapshot is explicit opt-in. Also add a help link explaining canaries and fallbacks.

ken: Perf: router.resolve is cheap per-view but could be heavy when listing many views. Suggest expand param to opt-in and cache previews per-tenant for ~60s.

sam: API draft: GET /api/v1/views/{id}?expand=effective_routing returns routing_preview and quota_hint; otherwise returns policy_id only. I'll PR today.

marta: Thanks — @sam tag @ken+@alex on PR. infra-bot: deploybot: preview-api/v2 canary scheduled 2025-06-20T16:00Z (build 8482).

ken: If list perf issues arise, consider batched resolve endpoint or server cache.

sam: Will post PR link when ready.

marta: Great, thanks! :+1:
